meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂工作拆成多个环节,派给多个助手并行执行并汇总结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务太重,想拆给多个 AI 助手分头做完再统一汇总。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a task is too big to do alone and you want several assistants to split it and report back.

howto.what: 当你要协调多个 Orca worker 时,Claude 会先定好本次会话用哪个 orca 可执行文件,再用 `ORCA skills get orchestration` 拉取与二进制版本匹配的指南,然后按其指示执行消息、任务分派等协调命令。
howto.when: 当你需要结构化地协调多个 agent 时——比如分派任务、等待 worker 完成或升级、协调任务 DAG 等——会接管。若只是完整所有权交接(hand off),则改用 orca-cli 技能。

say.text: 用 Orca 协调这几个 worker,把任务分派下去并等它们完成。
say.note: 先解析本会话的 orca 可执行文件,再按指南分派。

say.text: 帮我搭一个任务 DAG,按依赖顺序分派给各个 agent。
say.note: 先加载版本匹配指南,再沿 DAG 依赖分派。

say.text: 加载 orchestration 的版本匹配指南,看支持哪些协调命令。
say.note: 只打印指南内容,不执行别的动作。

howto.what_en: For multi-agent coordination, Claude first resolves the right orca executable for the session, loads the version-matched guide via `ORCA skills get orchestration`, then runs the coordination commands that guide specifies.
howto.when_en: Engages when you need structured multi-agent coordination: task dispatch, waiting on worker_done or escalation, coordinating a task DAG. Plain ownership handoffs go to the orca-cli skill instead.

say_en.text: Coordinate these workers with Orca: dispatch tasks and wait for them to finish.
say_en.note: Resolves the orca executable, then dispatches per the guide.

say_en.text: Build a task DAG and dispatch it to the agents in dependency order.
say_en.note: Loads the matched guide, then dispatches along the DAG.

say_en.text: Load the version-matched orchestration guide and list the coordination commands.
say_en.note: Prints the guide only; changes nothing.
